tool_calling_support: Suite ran over omp with --tools read,edit,write,bash,grep,glob (v1 wide set); v2 narrow set not recorded [uncertain]. Tool-calling was exercised only in the standalone curl gate (20/20 valid get_time tool calls via NexGate/coopforge, threshold >=90% -> PASS). In the omp suite the model predominantly answered as plain chat: edit tasks returned the requested code as markdown instead of using edit/write (0/8 edit tasks passed across both runs), cli tasks returned 'run this command' instructions or code snippets instead of invoking bash, and one response fabricated tool-call syntax verbatim ({'arguments': {'command': 'git diff'}, 'name': 'execute_code'}) for a non-existent tool 'execute_code' with hallucinated output. Dominant failure mode: no tool invocation / hallucinated tool use, not parser errors.
context_and_limits: TASK_TIMEOUT=300s per task (omp-bielik-tasks.sh default) enforced with timeout(1); verification via grep/eval in the task workdir; responses captured to response.txt. Walls: v1 170-301s, v2 203-302s; several tasks hit ~294-302s consistent with timeout kills (v1 edit-add-function/edit-rename-var, v2 edit-add-function/edit-fix-bug/log-tail; cli-grep 301s and cli-git-status 302s passed at the wire). Curl gate budget: 20 calls, max_tokens 256, 60s curl timeout each.
model_registration: Harness invocation: omp -p --no-session --no-skills --no-rules --no-extensions --no-lsp --no-title --tools read,edit,write,bash,grep,glob --system-prompt ~/.omp/bielik/SYSTEM.md --model <id> (v1 flags; v2 tool subset [uncertain]). Suite targets the coopforge/Bielik route through NexGate :4000, not the local llama-server. MCP servers (burdello, cloudflare, lustro-admin, etc.) still attempted connections each run despite --no-extensions; their connect warnings add startup latency and prompt noise (dozens of lines per response.txt). [uncertain]
flags_and_budget: Spec budget: system prompt + tool schemas <=3k tokens; SYSTEM.md ~3.1KB (~770 tokens); loop breaker stops after 3 identical tool errors. Measurement gaps vs plan: results JSON records only {task, pass, wall_s} — retries and tool_errors counters promised in the plan were never implemented; per-task pass/fail only. Baseline opencode+minimax-m3 suite never run; advisor A/B test never run. So <=1 retry and <=2 tool-errors/task acceptance criteria are unmeasurable from recorded data [uncertain].
litellm_route: Not directly exercised by the suite items beyond the shared NexGate :4000 endpoint used by both the curl gate and omp. Curl gate hit the route 20x with zero malformed calls. Route-level behavior (fallbacks, drop_params) belongs to item 'Lokalny bielik 11B v3.0 (llama-server :8082)'; suite JSON carries no per-request routing detail.
backend_serving: During suite runs the backend was coopforge Bielik behind NexGate (127.0.0.1:4000); the local llama-server :8082 instance was not the target. No backend-side telemetry captured per task (no token counts, no server logs correlated to tasks). Throughput context from co-located llama-server log (~10.5-12.7 t/s/slot) suggests ~300s tasks afford roughly 2-4k generated tokens — enough for chat answers but tight for multi-tool loops at 8192 ctx/slot [uncertain].
tool_call_rate: Curl gate: 100% valid tool calls (20/20, malformed 0) — single simple tool (get_time), tiny prompt, max_tokens 256. omp suite effective tool-use rate: ~0% for edit tasks (0/8), ~3/9..2/12 tasks passed overall; most responses contain zero real tool invocations. Divergence explained: gate tests parser validity in isolation; suite tests agentic tool selection under a 6-tool schema and multi-turn pressure, where the model defaults to answering directly. Per-task tool-call counts not recorded [uncertain].
streaming_behavior: Suite captured only final text (response.txt); no streaming metrics (TTFT, chunk cadence) recorded. Walls of ~294-302s with TASK_TIMEOUT=300 indicate tasks that talked past the limit and were killed mid-stream; responses ending mid-word (e.g. edit-fix-bug v2 ends 'def srednia(lista):') confirm truncation at kill. No SSE inspection performed [uncertain].
reasoning_core_gate: Reasoning-core gate item is tracked separately (see reasoning_core_gate_omp.json). For this suite: no reasoning-quality gate ran; only outcome pass/fail. Advisor A/B comparison planned in the design doc was not executed, so no reasoning-core signal exists for the suite runs. [uncertain]
pass_criteria: Spec target >=80% suite pass, <=1 retry/task, <=2 tool errors/task. Actual: v1 33% (3/9 recorded, run cancelled before remaining 3 tasks; full-run estimate would include log-grep-errors/git-status/git-diff [uncertain]), v2 16% (2/12). Both far below target -> FAIL. Edit class: 0/8 — model never uses edit/write tools. CLI class: 3/5 in v1 (cli-python-version/cli-grep/cli-git-status), 2/5 in v2 (cli-grep/cli-git-status); all passers at or near the 300s limit. Curl gate PASS (100%) is necessary but not sufficient: parser validity does not imply agentic tool selection. Conclusion recorded in batch-1 context holds: stock serving without proper tool parser/template fails the suite; fix belongs at serving layer (vLLM --tool-call-parser bielik or ollama advanced template), not at prompt level.
